description: Find Claude plugins by what they do. Every word of the query must appear in the plugin's name, description, category or tags; name matches come first. Filter by category or by source (official = Anthropic and partners in Anthropic's marketplaces).

category.description: Exact category name from list_categories, e.g. 'Marketing'.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. 'code review' or 'sales crm'. Omit to list.
